FullAnswer_EN: Yes, I really like travelling to new places.

Reason_EN: Because it is very interesting to see different cities and nature.

Example_EN: For example, last summer I visited Samarkand and saw many historical buildings.

ExtraInfo_EN: And also it is safer to travel in a group.
ExtraInfo_UZ: Shuningdek, guruh bo'lib sayohat qilish xavfsizroq.

FullAnswer_EN: I travel about two or three times a year.

Reason_EN: Because I have holidays at my school and I use this time.
Reason_UZ: Chunki mening o'qishimda ta'tillar bor va men bu vaqtdan foydalanaman.
Example_EN: For example, I usually go on a trip during my summer vacation.
Example_UZ: Masalan, odatda yozgi ta'tilim paytida sayohatga chiqaman.
ExtraInfo_EN: And also I want to travel more in the future.
ExtraInfo_UZ: Shuningdek, kelajakda ko'proq sayohat qilishni xohlayman.

FullAnswer_EN: I prefer to travel by car or by train.
FullAnswer_UZ: Men mashina yoki poezdda sayohat qilishni afzal ko'raman.
Reason_EN: Because these transports are very comfortable and fast.
Reason_UZ: Chunki ushbu transportlar juda qulay va tezkor.
Example_EN: For example, when we go to Tashkent we take the Afrosiyob train.
Example_UZ: Masalan, Toshkentga borganimizda Afrosiyob poezdiga chiqamiz.
ExtraInfo_EN: And also I like looking out the window at the view.
ExtraInfo_UZ: Shuningdek, derazadan manzarani tomosha qilishni yoqtiraman.

Sovollar: 1. What kind of transport do people use to travel?

FullAnswer_EN: People use many types of transport like buses, cars and planes.
FullAnswer_UZ: Odamlar avtobus, mashina va samolyot kabi ko'plab transport turlaridan foydalanishadi.
Reason_EN: Because some transport is faster and some is cheaper.
Reason_UZ: Chunki ba'zi transportlar tezroq, ba'zilari esa arzonroq.
Example_EN: For example, tourists take an airplane to travel to other countries.
Example_UZ: Masalan, sayyohlar boshqa davlatlarga borish uchun samolyotdan foydalanishadi.
ExtraInfo_EN: And also some people like walking or riding a bike.
ExtraInfo_UZ: Shuningdek, ba'zi odamlar piyoda yurishni yoki velosiped haydashni yoqtirishadi.

Sovollar: 2. Why do people want to travel?
Sovollar (UZ): Odamlar nima uchun sayohat qilishni xohlashadi?
FullAnswer_EN: People want to travel to relax and see the world.
FullAnswer_UZ: Odamlar dam olish va dunyoni ko'rish uchun sayohat qilishni xohlashadi.
Reason_EN: Because a change of place helps them to reduce stress.
Reason_UZ: Chunki joyning o'zgarishi ularga stressni kamaytirishga yordam beradi.
Example_EN: For example, families go to the mountains to have a good time together.
Example_UZ: Masalan, oilalar birgalikda vaqtni maroqli o'tkazish uchun tog'larga borishadi.
ExtraInfo_EN: And also they learn about different cultures.
ExtraInfo_UZ: Shuningdek, ular turli madaniyatlar haqida o'rganishadi.

FullAnswer_EN: My favourite hotel is a modern building with many rooms.
FullAnswer_UZ: Mening sevimli mehmonxonam ko'plab xonalarga ega zamonaviy binodir.

FullAnswer_EN: My last trip was to Bukhara with my friends.

FullAnswer_EN: No, I do not really like cold weather.
FullAnswer_UZ: Yo'q, menga sovuq ob-havo unchalik yoqmaydi.

ExtraInfo_EN: And also I prefer sunny and warm days.

Sovollar: 2. What is the weather like in your country?
FullAnswer_EN: The weather in my country is very different in every season.
FullAnswer_UZ: Mening mamlakatimda ob-havo har faslda juda xilma-xil.
Reason_EN: Because we have a continental climate with four seasons.
Reason_UZ: Chunki bizda to'rt faslli kontinental iqlim bor.
Example_EN: For example, summer is very hot and dry, but winter is cold.
Example_UZ: Masalan, yoz juda issiq va quruq, ammo qish sovuq bo'ladi.
ExtraInfo_EN: And also spring and autumn are very pleasant.
ExtraInfo_UZ: Shuningdek, bahor va kuz juda yoqimli.

FullAnswer_EN: It rains mostly in the spring and autumn months.
FullAnswer_UZ: Yomg'ir asosan bahor va kuz oylarida yog'adi.
Reason_EN: Because these seasons are more humid than summer.
Reason_UZ: Chunki bu fasllar yozga qaraganda namroq.
Example_EN: For example, in April, we often have light rain showers.
Example_UZ: Masalan, aprel oyida bizda tez-tez mayda yomg'irlar yog'ib turadi.
ExtraInfo_EN: And also rain makes the air very fresh.
ExtraInfo_UZ: Shuningdek, yomg'ir havoni juda toza qiladi.

FullAnswer_EN: My favorite season is definitely Autumn.
Reason_EN: Because the weather is not too hot and not too cold.
Reason_UZ: Chunki ob-havo juda issiq ham, juda sovuq ham emas.
Example_EN: For example, I love walking in the parks when the leaves change color.
Example_UZ: Masalan, barglar rangi o'zgarganda bog'larda sayr qilishni yaxshi ko'raman.
ExtraInfo_EN: And also there are many delicious fruits in this season.
ExtraInfo_UZ: Shuningdek, bu faslda ko'plab mazali mevalar bo'ladi.

Sovollar: 1. Describe the Spring season in your country.
FullAnswer_EN: Spring is a beautiful time when nature wakes up.
Reason_EN: Because the flowers start to bloom and the trees become green.
Reason_UZ: Chunki gullar gullashni boshlaydi va daraxtlar yashil rangga kiradi.
Example_EN: For example, we celebrate Navruz holiday and eat Sumalak.
Example_UZ: Masalan, biz Navro'z bayramini nishonlaymiz va sumalak yeymiz.
ExtraInfo_EN: And also the weather becomes warmer day by day.

Sovollar: 2. What activities do you do in warm weather?
FullAnswer_EN: I spend a lot of time outside during warm days.
FullAnswer_UZ: Issiq kunlarda men tashqarida ko'p vaqt o'tkazaman.
Reason_EN: Because the sun gives me energy to be active.
Reason_UZ: Chunki quyosh menga faol bo'lish uchun energiya beradi.
Example_EN: For example, I often go swimming or play football with my friends.
Example_UZ: Masalan, men ko'pincha cho'milishga boraman yoki do'stlarim bilan futbol o'ynayman.
ExtraInfo_EN: And also I like eating ice cream with my friends.
ExtraInfo_UZ: Shuningdek, do'stlarim bilan muzqaymoq yeyishni yoqtiraman.

Sovollar: 3. What activities do you do in cold weather?
FullAnswer_EN: In cold weather, I prefer indoor activities.
FullAnswer_UZ: Sovuq ob-havoda men bino ichidagi mashg'ulotlarni afzal ko'raman.
Reason_EN: Because it is better to stay warm and avoid getting sick.
Reason_UZ: Chunki issiqda qolish va kasal bo'lmaslik yaxshiroq.

Example_UZ: Masalan, menga issiq choy bilan film tomosha qilish yoki kitob o'qish yoqadi.
ExtraInfo_EN: And also I sometimes go to the mountains to see the snow.
ExtraInfo_UZ: Shuningdek, ba'zan qorni ko'rish uchun tog'ga boraman.

FullAnswer_EN: The best time to visit is during spring or autumn.
FullAnswer_UZ: Tashrif buyurish uchun eng yaxshi vaqt bahor yoki kuz faslidir.
Reason_EN: Because the weather is very mild and perfect for sightseeing.
Reason_UZ: Chunki ob-havo juda yumshoq va diqqatga sazovor joylarni ko'rish uchun mos.
Example_EN: For example, in May and September, it is not too hot or too cold.
Example_UZ: Masalan, may va sentyabr oylarida havo juda issiq ham, juda sovuq ham bo'lmaydi.
ExtraInfo_EN: And also they can enjoy fresh vegetables and fruits.
